title: mxv/new/v1
description: The workspace that the run created, or would create on a dry run.

dry_run.description: Present, and true, when the run was a dry run that changed nothing.

backend.description: The version-control system that made the checkout, which is `git`.

base.description:
The remote branch that the branch started from, such as
`refs/remotes/origin/main`.

branch.description: The branch that the checkout was created on.

commit.description:
The commit that the branch started at, or null in a dry run, which
does not fetch.

name.description: The repository's name, which names the checkout's directory.

PlacedRow.description:
One workspace and the workspace root that the run used, as `new` and
`show` print it.

branch.description: The branch that the workspace's checkouts were created on.

checkouts.description: The workspace's checkouts, one for each repository.

name.description:
The workspace's name, which is also the name of its directory and of
its checkouts' branch.

path.description:
The workspace's directory, which `mxv cd` prints. It comes from the
workspace's record, so it stays where the workspace was created when
the root changes later.

repositories.description:
The top-level directory of each repository that the workspace checks
out.

root.description:
The workspace root that the run used, in which `new` creates a
workspace's directory.

root_source.description:
Where the root came from: `env` for `MXV_ROOT`, `config` for the
config file's `root`, or `default` for
`$XDG_DATA_HOME/mxv/workspaces`.

RootSource.description: Where the workspace root came from.

oneOf.description: Neither named one, so it is `$XDG_DATA_HOME/mxv/workspaces`.
